name: 健康保険・介護保険 (Kyokai Kenpo health and nursing care insurance)
authority: 健康保険法 arts.40 (標準報酬月額 grades 1–50, 58,000–1,390,000), 45 (標準賞与額: the bonus with fractions under 1,000 yen dropped, at most 5,730,000 in a fiscal year), 156, 160 and 161 (the premium is the standard remuneration times the rate, borne equally) and 167 (the employer deducts the employee half from wages); 介護保険法 art.9(2) and 健康保険法 art.156(1)(i): a person aged 40 to 64 (第2号被保険者) also pays the nursing care rate, from the month in which the day before the 40th birthday falls until the month before the day before the 65th birthday (年齢計算ニ関スル法律; 健保法156条3項). Rates: 全国健康保険協会 令和7年度 (令和7年3月分から) 都道府県単位保険料率 by the employer's prefecture (company.region) — https://www.kyoukaikenpo.or.jp/about/business/insurance_rate/rate_prefectures/r07 — and the nationwide nursing care rate 1.59%. 高齢者の医療の確保に関する法律 art.50: from the 75th birthday the person leaves employee health insurance. The employee half is rounded by 通貨の単位及び貨幣の発行等に関する法律 art.3 as the 協会けんぽ table states (50 sen or less dropped, over 50 sen raised to 1 yen); the employer bears the rest of the yen-truncated total. Premiums run for every month of insured status, with or without pay that month (health and pension rows assess without a wage, 健康保険法 arts.156, 161): a month with no pay is advanced by the employer and recovered from the next pay (SI_PREVIOUS_MONTH). The months of maternity and childcare leave are exempt (健康保険法 arts.159, 159の3: a month the leave covers at its end, or 14 days or more within it), as is a person under a social security agreement certificate (HEALTH election social_security_agreement_exempt) and the nursing part for a 40–64 insured person not domiciled in Japan (care_exempt; 介護保険法 art.9(2)). A multiple-employer insured person pays the share the pension office apportions (apportionment_ratio; 健保則 art.1の2). The standard monthly remuneration is the grade the pension office decided (the HEALTH election standard_monthly_remuneration: 資格取得時決定, 定時決定 and 随時改定, arts.41–43); without it the contract monthly wage is graded (art.42 資格取得時決定). A health insurance society employer (company.facts.health_insurer SOCIETY) uses its own rates and employee share (健康保険法 arts.160(13), 160の2, 162; customer input: society_health_rate_percent, society_care_rate_percent, society_support_levy_rate_percent, society_employee_share). A month in which the insured status is both acquired and lost (同月得喪) is charged (健康保険法 art.156(3) proviso, 厚生年金保険法 art.19(2)). Collection (健康保険法 art.167): the employee half of a month is deducted from the pay of the following month; where the pay falls in the same month (period.pay_date on or before the month end) the slip deducts the previous month's premium instead (SI_PREVIOUS_MONTH), and a leaver at a month end has both months deducted from the final pay (art.167(1) proviso). 定時決定 (art.41) and 随時改定 (art.43) warnings compare the recorded grade with the April–June and the last three months' remuneration. Remuneration in kind (健康保険法 art.46, 厚生年金保険法 art.25) enters the 報酬月額 the contract wage is graded on and the 定時決定/随時改定 averages: the IN_KIND part (MEALS_IN_KIND_SOCIAL_INSURANCE, HOUSING_IN_KIND_SOCIAL_INSURANCE at the 告示 price). A leave starting and ending within one month exempts it when its days are 14 or more, the days of every 育児休業等 in that month added together and a 出生時育児休業 counted less the days worked under it (leave facts.work_days) (健康保険法 art.159(1)(ii) with 健康保険法施行規則 art.135(4); 厚生年金保険法 art.81の2). No premium for a month that ends after the insured status was lost (the day after the exit), the month of loss itself included unless it is a 同月得喪 month (健康保険法 art.156(3); 厚生年金保険法 art.19(1)): a payment after the exit (a retirement allowance) is charged none. A commuter pass paid for several months (COMMUTER_PASS, terms.facts.commuter_pass_months) enters these averages spread evenly over the months it covers (健康保険法 art.3(5); 日本年金機構: 6か月定期券は1か月当たりの額を各月の報酬に算入).

authority: 健康保険法 art.167(1) and 厚生年金保険法 art.84(1): the employer may deduct from the pay only the employee's premium of the previous month (of the previous and the current month for a leaver). name: 源泉所得税及び復興特別所得税 (salary and bonus withholding)
authority: 所得税法 arts.183, 185 and 186 with 復興財源確保法 arts.28–31: the 2026 月額表 — 甲欄 when the 給与所得者の扶養控除等申告書 is filed with this employer (art.194; INCOME_TAX election dependency_declaration_filed) by the 電算機計算の特例 (https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2026/data/denshi_01.pdf), otherwise the 乙欄 transcribed row by row, less 1,610 yen per dependant on a 従たる給与 declaration (secondary_dependants). The base is the payment's salary less the social insurance premiums deducted from it (art.185(1)(i): charged.month of HEALTH, CHILD_SUPPORT, PENSION, EI and SI_PREVIOUS_MONTH) and the non-taxable commuting allowance (art.9(1)(v), 施行令 art.20の2: the reasonable fare up to 150,000 a month; a car commuter by one-way distance band (raised from 1 April 2025 to 38,700 at 55 km or more; NTA https://www.nta.go.jp/users/gensen/2025tsukin/pdf/01.pdf); a commuter pass paid for several months is exempt up to the limit times the months it covers, terms.facts.commuter_pass_months). Bonus (art.186): the rate the previous month's salary after its premiums sets (earned.previous_month); with no previous salary, or a bonus above ten times it, the 月額表 on one sixth of the bonus — one twelfth where the bonus period exceeds six months (art.186(2); BONUS_OVER_SIX_MONTHS). The table year follows the pay day (governed_by pay_date: 所得税法 art.185, the tables apply to pay payable from 1 January). Non-residents (arts.161(1)(xii), 212, 213): 20.42% of the domestic-source pay — the share of service performed in Japan (terms.facts.domestic_service_ratio), an officer's pay wholly — unless a tax treaty exempts it on the 租税条約に関する届出書 (INCOME_TAX election treaty_exempt). Pay frequencies (art.185(1)(i)–(iii)): a WEEKLY or DAILY entity withholds each payment on the 日額表 (PAYROLL withholding_daily_table, by the pay day’s year) — the 日割額 (the payment’s salary after its own premiums, over the days of the period) looked up and multiplied by those days; a 日雇 paid per day worked (terms.facts.daily_wage_earner) on the 丙欄 per day worked; a SEMI_MONTHLY or TEN_DAY entity on the 月額表 at twice or three times the payment, the tax halved or thirded (fractions under 1 yen dropped). Each payment is withheld on its own: the month’s earlier slips keep theirs (charged.month), their bonus withholding counted once.

name: 退職所得の源泉徴収 (retirement income withholding)
authority: 所得税法 arts.30, 199, 201 and 203 with 復興財源確保法 art.28: a retirement allowance (and a 解雇予告手当, 所得税基本通達30-5) is taxed apart from salary. With the 退職所得の受給に関する申告書 (art.203; the RETIREMENT_TAX election retirement_income_declaration_filed): the deduction is 400,000 a year of service up to 20 years (at least 800,000) and 700,000 a year beyond, a part year counting as a year (art.30(3), 施行令69条); half the remainder is taxed, except that for service of 5 years or less the remainder above 3,000,000 is taxed in full (art.30(4), 短期退職手当等); fractions under 1,000 yen dropped; then the 退職所得の源泉徴収税額の速算表 (5%–45% less 0–4,796,000) times 102.1%, under 1 yen truncated (https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2026/data/18.pdf). Without the declaration: 20.42% of the payment (art.201(3)). Service is the employment's service months at the start of the payment month. A retirement caused by becoming disabled adds 1,000,000 to the deduction (art.30(6)(iii); RETIREMENT_TAX election retirement_due_to_disability); a specified officer (特定役員) of 5 years or less is taxed on the whole remainder, without halving (art.30(5); election specified_officer). The deduction of a service overlapping an earlier retirement allowance is reduced as 所得税法 art.30(6)(i)–(ii) computes it (RETIREMENT_TAX election retirement_deduction_adjustment). A non-resident is withheld 20.42% of the part for service in Japan (arts.161(1)(xii)ハ, 212, 213; terms.facts.retirement_domestic_ratio); the 選択課税 of art.171 is the employee's own return. The table follows the pay day.

name: 住民税 特別徴収 (resident tax special collection)
authority: 地方税法 arts.321の3, 321の4 and 321の5: the employer deducts the individual resident tax each month from June to the following May in the amounts the municipality's 特別徴収税額決定通知書 states — the June amount (which carries the rounding remainder) and the July–May monthly amount (the RESIDENT_TAX elections june_amount and monthly_amount, replaced each June by the new notice) — and pays it by the 10th of the next month. Not charged without a notice amount. On leaving (地方税法 art.321の5(2)): after a January–April exit the remaining monthly amounts to May are collected from the final pay or retirement allowance where it exceeds them; after a June–December exit only on the employee's request (RESIDENT_TAX election lump_sum_on_exit).
